description: Header file defining CRC32 checksum functions with multiple algorithms and lookup table configurations, including slicing-by-4, 8, 16, and tableless variants, for use in the caffe2 serialization component.

methods.name: crc32_fast
methods.description: Selects and computes the fastest CRC32 algorithm based on compile-time flags for large datasets.

methods.name: crc32_combine
methods.description: Merges two CRC32 checksums to produce a combined checksum for concatenated data.

methods.name: crc32_bitwise
methods.description: Computes CRC32 using a bitwise algorithm.

methods.name: crc32_halfbyte
methods.description: Computes CRC32 using a half-byte lookup table algorithm.

methods.name: crc32_1byte
methods.description: Computes CRC32 using a byte-wise lookup table algorithm.

methods.name: crc32_1byte_tableless
methods.description: Computes CRC32 without lookup tables, byte-wise.

methods.name: crc32_4x8bytes
methods.description: Unrolled version of slicing-by-8 for four blocks.

methods.name: crc32_16bytes_prefetch
methods.description: Computes CRC32 with slicing-by-16 and prefetching for performance.
